reimbursement_guidelines.title: Reimbursement Guidelines
reimbursement_guidelines.content:
As a Medicare Advantage plan, we have developed payment policies to explain coverage more fully for services. The criteria outlined will apply to Medicare Advantage plans except when the procedure(s) has established criteria through the Original Medicare National Coverage Determinations (NCDs) and Local Coverage Determinations (LCDs) as outlined below. In addition to the policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements.

Measurement of apolipoprotein B (Apo B) (CPT code 82172**) IS REIMBURSABLE for individuals with any of the following:

Disorder of galactose, lipoprotein, or amino acid transport metabolism

Once per lifetime measurement of lipoprotein (a) [Lp(a)] (CPT code 83695**) IS REIMBURSABLE for individuals 18 years of age or older.

Measurement of homocysteine (CPT code 83090****) or conventional measurement of C-reactive protein (CPT code 86140) as a part of a risk assessment for cardiovascular disease (CVD) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE.

Measurement of novel lipid and non-lipid biomarkers (CPT code 82610*, CPT code 83700**, CPT code 83701**, CPT code 83704**, CPT code 83719**, CPT code 83880***, CPT code 85384, CPT code 85415) as a part of a risk assessment for CVD IS NOT REIMBURSABLE.

Direct measurement of small dense low-density lipoprotein (LDL) (CPT code 83722) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE except in diagnoses of Cushings syndrome, chronic kidney disease (CKD), obstruction of the bile duct or pregnancy.

CVD risk panels consisting of multiple individual biomarkers intended to assess CVD (CPT code 0052U, CPT code 0308U**, CPT code 0309U**, CPT code 0415U**, CPT code 0541U**) ARE NOT REIMBURSABLE.

Measurement of lipoprotein-associated phospholipase A2 (Lp-PLA2) (CPT code 83698****) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE.

All other biomarker panels designed to detect CVD risk (CPT code 0019M**, CPT code 0377U) ARE NOT REIMBURSABLE.

Measurement of components of a lipid panel (CPT code 82465*****, CPT code 83718*****, and CPT code 84478*****) ARE NOT REIMBURSABLE on the same date of service as a lipid panel (CPT code 80061*****).
